people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Yahweh is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
translations.bsb: The LORD is exalted, for He dwells on high; He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
translations.kjv: The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
translations.asv: Jehovah is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
